---
title: "Life Outside Work"
---

::: {style="max-width: 1100px; margin: 40px auto; text-align: justify;"}

Outside of work, most of my free time goes to two things: photography and aviation.

I shoot mostly landscapes and cityscapes. A selection is below; more lives on my [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/@srivatsan){target="_blank"} profile.

I am also a virtual pilot and an S1-trainee air traffic controller with VATUSA, the United States Division of [VATSIM](https://www.vatsim.net){target="_blank"}.

:::

<hr style="max-width: 1100px; margin: 30px auto 0;">

<p style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-caption, #bbbbbb); margin: 18px auto 0;">A collection of my hand-picked photos.</p>

<div id="photo-gallery" class="fj-gallery"></div>

<!-- ── Justified mosaic (fjGallery) + lightbox (lightGallery) ── -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flickr-justified-gallery@2/dist/fjGallery.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/lightgallery/2.8.3/css/lightgallery-bundle.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flickr-justified-gallery@2/dist/fjGallery.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/lightgallery/2.8.3/lightgallery.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/lightgallery/2.8.3/plugins/zoom/lg-zoom.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/lightgallery/2.8.3/plugins/thumbnail/lg-thumbnail.umd.min.js"></script>

<style>
#photo-gallery {
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 25px auto 40px;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
}
#photo-gallery.is-ready { opacity: 1; }
#photo-gallery .gallery-item {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: zoom-in;
}
#photo-gallery .gallery-item img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.6s ease, filter 0.6s ease;
}
#photo-gallery .gallery-item:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  filter: brightness(0.7);
}
#photo-gallery .lg-hover {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--accent, #FDD26E);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#photo-gallery .gallery-item:hover .lg-hover { opacity: 1; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  // Edit this list to add or remove photos.
  var photos = [
    { file: "photos/PXL_20220323_021751755.jpg",                       caption: "Sunset panoramic view of downtown Seattle with Mt. Rainier in the background" },
    { file: "photos/PXL_20211226_185354224.jpg",                       caption: "The Quad at the University of Washington" },
    { file: "photos/IMG_1405.jpg",                                     caption: "Coal Creek, Washington" },
    { file: "photos/srivatsan-balaji-Hv76ddFqKH4-unsplash.jpg",        caption: "Golden Gardens Park, Washington" },
    { file: "photos/PXL_20220731_064619756.NIGHT~2.jpg",               caption: "" },
    { file: "photos/PXL_20240418_010033230~2.jpg",                     caption: "" },
    { file: "photos/PXL_20250514_231324573.jpg",                       caption: "" },
    { file: "photos/srivatsan-balaji-wZMVYtJXHm0-unsplash.jpg",        caption: "" },
    { file: "photos/PXL_20240922_014702847.LONG_EXPOSURE-01.COVER.jpg", caption: "Snoqualmie Falls, Washington" },
    { file: "photos/PXL_20250514_231425261~2.jpg",                     caption: "Hudson Bay" },
    { file: "photos/PXL_20240101_221804405.jpg",                       caption: "Drumheller Fountain at the UW" },
    { file: "photos/srivatsan-balaji-8L18q92WX8g-unsplash.jpg",        caption: "" },
    { file: "photos/srivatsan-balaji-NN6gNzLlfEM-unsplash.jpg",        caption: "" },
    { file: "photos/srivatsan-balaji-T632eMad9E8-unsplash.jpg",        caption: "" },
    { file: "photos/srivatsan-balaji-vvpqI98fT60-unsplash.jpg",        caption: "" },
    { file: "photos/srivatsan-balaji-WCjeeeBJEH4-unsplash.jpg",        caption: "" }
  ];

  var gallery = document.getElementById("photo-gallery");
  if (!gallery) return;

  gallery.innerHTML = photos.map(function (p) {
    var cap = p.caption ? p.caption.replace(/"/g, "&quot;") : "";
    var capAttr = cap ? ' data-sub-html="' + cap + '"' : '';
    var alt = cap || "Photograph by Srivatsan Balaji";
    return '<a class="fj-gallery-item gallery-item" href="' + p.file + '"' + capAttr + '>'
         +   '<img src="' + p.file + '" alt="' + alt + '">'
         +   '<span class="lg-hover"><i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass-plus"></i></span>'
         + '</a>';
  }).join("");

  function rowH() {
    var w = window.innerWidth;
    return w < 600 ? 150 : (w < 1000 ? 200 : 240);
  }

  var tries = 0;
  function init() {
    if (typeof fjGallery === "undefined" || typeof lightGallery === "undefined") {
      if (++tries > 60) { gallery.classList.add("is-ready"); return; }  // reveal anyway if CDN fails
      setTimeout(init, 50);
      return;
    }

    var els = document.querySelectorAll("#photo-gallery");

    fjGallery(els, {
      itemSelector: ".fj-gallery-item",
      rowHeight: rowH(),
      gutter: 10,
      lastRow: "left",
      rowHeightTolerance: 0.25,
      onJustify: function () { gallery.classList.add("is-ready"); }
    });

    lightGallery(gallery, {
      selector: ".gallery-item",
      plugins: [lgZoom, lgThumbnail],
      speed: 400,
      download: false,
      zoomFromOrigin: false,
      licenseKey: "0000-0000-000-0000"  // silences console notice; GPLv3 use for this open-source site
    });

    var lastRH = rowH(), rt;
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
      clearTimeout(rt);
      rt = setTimeout(function () {
        var nh = rowH();
        if (nh !== lastRH) { lastRH = nh; fjGallery(els, "updateOptions", { rowHeight: nh }); }
      }, 200);
    });
  }

  init();
})();
</script>
